title: Chithravarnam 2.0
tagline: A trans-Tasman tour across Wellington, Auckland and Adelaide
description: Chithravarnam returned for its most ambitious edition yet, taking the stage across Wellington and Auckland before closing out in Adelaide - a three-city tour blending classical and contemporary Malayalam music for the diaspora across New Zealand and Australia.

shows.venue: Kiri Te Kanawa Theatre, Aotea Centre
